directAnswer.en: This is indoor mortar or plaster spraying. It is not a trailer-pump pour. This electric row needs 380 V and 7.5 kW. If that supply is present, do not move the job onto the diesel 511. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Type 511 at 380 V, 7.5 kW, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 30 m horizontal / 15 m vertical, hose 32/38 mm, particle ≤6 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1700 × 550 × 900 mm and 260 kg. Do not move the same condition onto Type 511 Diesel, which prints diesel engine, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 30 m horizontal / 15 m vertical, hose 32/38 mm, particle ≤6 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1600 × 1200 × 450 mm and 360 kg. No kilowatt figure is printed. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

heading.en: What the indoor spray has to match

body.en: This is indoor mortar or plaster spraying. It is not a trailer-pump pour. This electric row needs 380 V and 7.5 kW. If that supply is present, do not move the job onto the diesel 511. The published Type 511 row is 380 V, 7.5 kW, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 30 m horizontal / 15 m vertical, hose 32/38 mm, particle ≤6 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1700 × 550 × 900 mm and 260 kg.
body.zh: 这是室内砂浆或石膏喷涂。不是拖泵浇筑。这一电动行需要 380V、7.5 kW。现场有这个电源，就不要把作业挪到柴油 511。已公布的511型是380V、7.5 kW、3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、水平 30 m / 垂直 15 m、管径 32/38 mm、粒径 ≤6 mm、砂灰比 ≤1:3、外形 1700 × 550 × 900 mm、260 kg。

heading.en: Do not swap the sprayer rows

No kilowatt figure is printed. The shared job site in the photograph does not merge the two tables. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

body.en: Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the material, the largest particle, the sand-cement ratio, the hose length you measured, and whether the site can supply the printed power. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job, a price or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请把材料、最大粒径、砂灰比、量到的软管长度，以及现场能否按已印动力供电，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。

question.en: Is the photograph a Pinjin jobsite?

answer.en: No. It shows this kind of work. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not name it as a contract record.
answer.zh: 不是。它表示的是这类工况。河北品锦机械没有把它写成合同记录。

question.en: What does the Type 511 row print for this check?

answer.en: This electric row needs 380 V and 7.5 kW. If that supply is present, do not move the job onto the diesel 511.

question.en: Is the printed output a contract volume?
question.zh: 印出的输送量是合同方量吗？

answer.en: No. Type 511 prints theoretical catalogue figures only. This page names no floor, no contract volume and no price.
answer.zh: 不是。511型只印理论目录数字。本页不写楼层、合同方量或价格。
